+title: 'Router: resolve models through the Extras ModelPool, one hold for each key'
+---
+## What
+Decision (user, 2026-09-26): the router uses the process-wide pool in the Extras `ModelPool` product, so that the router, the registry and other users share one copy of each model in memory.
+
+Blocked by Extras task 01M3FN95AM98RJSTCVQ8G1Z7KE (the pool actor: key = `ModelRef` + role, an opaque container, a loader protocol with no slot, one hold for each key, the resolve lock, the byte ledger, a residency-change hook). The Extras work must be pushed first.
+
+- Remove `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/ModelPool.swift` and `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/ResidencyHold.swift`. Use the Extras pool and its hold type.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Router.swift`:
+  - `init(... pool: ModelPool = .shared)` (line 103) uses the Extras `ModelPool.shared`.
+  - `resolve` (lines 212-366): keep the resolve lock around the full resolve, and keep `JointFit` reading the pool's resident footprint and keys. Change each `acquire` to the Extras call with key = `ModelRef` + role and the router loader. Change `grant(token:charges:)` and `release(charges:)` to one hold for each key.
+  - Map `ModelSlot` to the pool role in the router. `ModelSlot` stays a router type.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/LanguageModelProfile.swift:118`: `RoutedModel` keeps the Extras holds of its slots.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/ModelLoader.swift` and `LiveModelLoader.swift`: the router loader conforms to the Extras loader protocol. If the load needs the slot (lines 822, 907, 1008, 1018), the router gives it when it makes the loader, not through the pool.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Sizing/PromptCacheBudget.swift`: resize the prompt cache from the pool's residency-change hook.
+- The router casts the opaque pool container to `LoadedLLMContainer` or `LoadedEmbeddingContainer`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The router has no pool actor and no residency hold type of its own.
+- [ ] Two routers on `ModelPool.shared` that resolve the same `ModelRef` cause one load.
+- [ ] A model is evicted when the last router profile that holds it is released, as before.
+- [ ] `swift build` passes with no warnings on a clean build.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update the router pool tests (for example `ModelPoolTests`, the residency and eviction tests, and the `JointFit` tests with residents) to use the Extras pool.
+- [ ] Add a test in `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/`: a router and a direct `ModelPool.acquire` for the same key with a stub loader cause one load, and the model stays resident until both release it.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes, and the output shows the full count of tests run.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #model-pool #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file
